concept.hook: Frame 1: a mid-air freeze on the beat against a neon-magenta void.
concept.angle: A hip-hop power-move combo locked to the drop, looped invisibly.
concept.script: 0:00 hard cut into a mid-air freeze, then a power-move combo locked to the beat; the final pose returns to the opening frame for an invisible loop.
concept.visual_prompt: A single dancer, hip-hop power moves, mid-peak motion, isolated on a solid neon-magenta background, metallic reflective outfit catching light, 4K, no artifacts. Loop-ready.
concept.comment_bait_question: Name a song harder than this
concept.on_screen_text: Name a song harder than this
concept.title: Name a song harder than this #aidance #shorts
concept.description: AI dance to Bruno Mars - I Just Might. Drop the song you want next below.

score.judge_rationale: Strong frame-1 peak motion, stark background, and a smooth loop. Weakest on engagement bait - the comment-bait question is present but not polarizing enough to force typed replies. Growing tier; one fix from viral.
score.rationale: engagement_bait is the ceiling at 11/20; see category_breakdown.
score.recommended_fix_priority: Sharpen the comment-bait question into a polarizing, typed-answer prompt and keep it on-screen the full duration (EB-01/EB-02/EB-03).

harness_diff.script_prompt_change: Require a polarizing, ranked/comparison typed-answer question burned on-screen for the full duration.
harness_diff.rationale: engagement_bait was the lowest category (11/20); reinforce comment bait + polarization to lift the total toward the viral threshold.

lesson.observation: The video scored well on hook and loop but engagement_bait capped the total at 76 (growing) - the question was answerable with an emoji.
lesson.rule: Use polarizing, typed-answer comment bait (ranking/comparison) kept on-screen the full duration.
lesson.evidence: Generation 1 ACOE: hook_quality 26/30, engagement_bait 11/20, total 76 -> growing tier.
lesson.harness_change: Raise comment_bait_question (+0.15) and polarizing_angle (+0.10); update script_prompt to demand a polarizing typed-answer question.
lesson.expected_effect: engagement_bait climbs toward 18-20/20, pushing the total past 85 into the viral tier.
